prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet for a Korean children's 2D fantasy classroom RPG. Redesign a baby star monster as an extremely sweet simple plump five-pointed baby star, round soft stubby tips, creamy butter-yellow body with a faint lavender edge, tiny oval dark eyes with one highlight, little curved smile, peach cheeks, no limbs beyond its five soft star points, no scary face. Delicate hand-painted storybook 2D game artwork, soft shading and fine warm outline, not shiny 3D plastic. Exactly 8 full-body poses of the SAME character arranged in a precise uniform 4 column x 2 row grid on actual transparent background, landscape 2:1 canvas, equal square cells, no separators or text. Each character centered at the same pivot and same scale in its cell, occupies at most 65 percent cell width/height with clear margins. Reading order left-to-right: 1 relaxed idle; 2 small crouch preparing a friendly bump; 3 stronger crouch leaning back to left; 4 springs forward to RIGHT with star tips stretching slightly; 5 maximum gentle bump to RIGHT eyes determined but still cute; 6 follows through with cheeks puffed; 7 settles back towards neutral; 8 relaxed neutral again. Actual clearly distinct body poses and expressions, not duplicates and not rotating the entire same drawing. No detached particles, no weapons, no shadows, no glow outside silhouette, no stars or moons held in hands. All 8 complete silhouettes isolated, consistent face and palette. This is a usable animation sheet, not a scene.

Keep the blue shell, yellow crescent and stars, tiny legs and cheerful expression.

additional.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image shows the exact character and general attack idea, NOT the background. Create a NEW eight frame 2D attack sprite sheet of this white-haired celestial boy king with ornate golden crown, purple-blue cape and gem staff. MUST be isolated cutout sprites on fully transparent alpha, absolutely NO colored backdrop, NO purple rectangle and no floor. Same character in eight distinct consecutive staff-casting poses: neutral, pull staff back, charge staff, lift staff, point staff forward, follow through, lower staff, neutral. Keep magic small close to staff, no large detached swirls. Arrange exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows in a 2:1 landscape sheet, square equal cells. The complete body including staff, cape and crown occupies only 55% of every cell's dimensions; extensive EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutters and outer margins. Character faces right, fixed scale and consistent feet baseline. No text or grid. Use same hand-painted cute fantasy RPG art as reference, not 3D. Background transparency is the principal requirement.
